name: Verdan the Everliving
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Verdan the Everliving lurks in deep tunnels and attacks those who enter. He dwells near the sleeping druid Naralex and the Druids of the Fang.

sections.title: Beast of the Lush Depths
sections.body: Verdan is the largest bog beast in the overgrown depths of the Wailing Caverns. He is an elemental of foliage, silt, and mire, haunting its flooded hollows. Nothing is known of him from before corruption reached the caverns.

sections.title: Twisted by the Nightmare
sections.body: Verdan roams the depths with the mad Druids of the Fang. Naralex tried to turn the dry Barrens into a lush paradise, but his ritual broke into a vivid nightmare within the Emerald Dream. Corruption seeped through the subterranean waters and tainted every living thing in the cavern.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Verdan?
faq.answer: Verdan is a massive bog beast, an elemental animated from plant matter, peat, and subterranean mire.

faq.q: Why is Verdan hostile to adventurers?
faq.answer: Verdan lurks in the nightmare-tainted depths of the Wailing Caverns, where the sleeping Naralex's dream has turned everything hostile. He treats all who enter as trespassers to crush.

faq.q: What is Verdan's connection to the Druids of the Fang?
faq.answer: Verdan shares the nightmare-tainted caverns with the insane Druids of the Fang. Like them, he is hostile to intruders and guards the deeper reaches.

faq.q: Where in the Wailing Caverns is Verdan located?
faq.answer: Verdan dwells in a mossy chamber deep along the winding paths of the Wailing Caverns, past several corrupted leaders of the Fang.

faq.q: Can Verdan be cured or cleansed?
faq.answer: No known way can cleanse Verdan, so adventurers must destroy the hulking beast to pass safely through the cavern.
No one knows why Verdan bears the name the Everliving. He is a bog beast of the Wailing Caverns' lush, overgrown depths.

angles.text: Verdan's lair shows what grows in the caverns when the Emerald Dream turns to nightmare.
Verdan is an elemental spirit of earth and water, warped into violence. Putting him down restores balance to the Barrens' fractured elements.
The Wailing Caverns lie at the heart of the Barrens. Defeating dangerous beasts like Verdan helps protect nearby crossroads and settlements.
